title: Issues: labels, assignees, filters, and 'Closes #N' auto-close
description: Review finding #7 (2026-06-24): labels and assignees exist in schema only; issue lists have no filters; commit/PR messages with 'Closes #N' neither cross-reference nor close issues. Promised-but-missing surface with daily-use friction — highest-priority debt from the product review.
close_reason: Labels/assignees/milestones/label-filters were already built since the June review. Added the genuinely missing parts: Closes #N auto-close on default-branch merges, #N autolinking in issue bodies/comments, /issues/N→/pulls/N redirect. Commit 02a5ff8.

title: Signed-commit enforcement silently disabled on non-initial pushes (empty argv element)
description: main-git.lisp:183-184: (if zero "--max-count=50" "") puts an empty string in git rev-list argv when old is not all-zeros. git fatals ('ambiguous argument'), %unsigned-commits returns NIL on non-zero exit, and %enforce-protected-branches treats NIL as 'no unsigned commits' — push allowed. Fix: build the arg list conditionally, and consider failing closed on rev-list errors. Found during whittling sweep 2026-09-12.
close_reason: Fixed: argv built without empty element; enforcement now fails closed when rev-list errors

title: Forked repos get divergent hooks: no post-receive callback (no push events/workflows/sig verification)
description: server-repos.lisp:122-139 fork-repo-submit hand-writes pre/post-receive hooks instead of calling install-repo-hooks (server-api.lisp:521). The inline copy omits the curl callback to /-/internal/hook/post-receive, so pushes to forks produce no push events, trigger no workflows, and skip signature verification. Fix: replace the block with (install-repo-hooks dest-path username repo-name). Found during whittling sweep 2026-09-12.
close_reason: fork-repo-submit now calls install-repo-hooks (same hooks + chown as every repo); existing forks already self-heal via reinstall-all-hooks at startup

title: Git blame and per-file history views
description: Most-reached-for missing forge feature. Blame view with per-line commit links + relative ages, and a History button on blob pages (git log -- path). Read-path only, chamber-friendly (chamber-or fallback like other reads).
close_reason: Blame + history views shipped in 1a9ba9f; parser verified against real repo (79/79 lines, 5 hunks).

title: OCI artifact registry (distribution API)
description: Serve OCI artifacts from Cave: container images from CI and mirrored ocicl systems, so builds stop depending on ghcr.io (which throttled ocicl downloads hard on 2026-09-12 and broke cave's own image builds). Implement the OCI distribution API with Postgres metadata + disk blobs.

title: Beads tab: render refs/dolt/data issues on repo pages
description: Cave already hosts refs/dolt/data for every repo that syncs beads but shows none of it. Add a read-only Beads tab: ready/open/blocked lists, dependency graph, issue detail — reading from the .beads JSONL export or a dolt read. Uniquely differentiating; write support later.

title: Runner secrets: injection with masking
description: Review finding #6 remainder: no secrets are injected into workflow jobs yet. Add per-repo secrets, inject as env vars, mask values in captured logs, and consider trusted-vs-untrusted runner separation.

title: Deploys: build the engine or cut it from launch docs
description: Review finding #3 (strategic fork): deploys are schema-only (db.lisp:251). Either build the real engine (.cave/deploy.toml, queue, podman build/run, rollback, secrets) or remove deploys from the documented surface. Decide before more feature work piles on top.

title: Merge eligibility Rules 2 and 3 are still ':pass t' stubs
description: From the review backlog: Rule 2 (target branch exists) and Rule 3 (no concurrent merge in flight) in compute-merge-eligibility always pass. Implement real checks so merge protection is honest end to end.
close_reason: Rule 2 was already real (target-branch + conflicts rules); added Rule 3 as per-repo merge claim enforced in perform-pr-merge, advisory rule in eligibility panel. Commit cef5877.

title: Stacked PRs: atomic stack landing
description: Review finding #4: stacks are tracked and displayed, but merge is single-PR only. Landing a stack should merge the chain atomically (or with clean sequential rebase), with rollback on mid-stack failure.

title: Show relative commit age in commit listings (like GitHub)
description: Repo home 'Recent commits', the last-commit bar, and the single-commit page showed no indication of when a commit happened (or only the raw %ai string). Add relative ages ('2 days ago') with the absolute date as hover title.
close_reason: Shipped in ef8f2b0

title: CI: 'Fetch Lisp dependencies' step doesn't fail on ocicl download errors
description: In the containers.yaml workflow, 'ocicl install' logs '; error downloading and installing <system>' on transient ghcr.io failures but still exits 0, so the step passes and the build later dies with a confusing MISSING-DEPENDENCY (e.g. 'Component uax-15 not found, required by cl-postgres' in run 34714926430, where 8 of ~141 downloads failed). Fix options: grep the ocicl install output for 'error downloading' and fail/retry the step, or add a retry loop around ocicl install, or fix ocicl itself to exit non-zero when a pinned system fails to install (atgreen owns ocicl — upstream fix may be best).
close_reason: Fixed in f85bd65 at the workflow level: retry loop greps ocicl install output for 'error downloading', retries up to 5x, fails the step loudly. Proved itself immediately (59 error/retry lines on the first green run). Upstream ocicl exit-code fix tracked separately.

title: cave-shell.sh: strip all leading slashes from REPO_PATH (double-slash remote URLs cause acquire 404 + client retry storm)
description: A beads dolt remote URL with a double slash (git+ssh://cave@host//atgreen/house) makes git send 'git-receive-pack //atgreen/house'. cave-shell.sh's sed 's|^/||' strips only ONE leading slash, so the push-lock URL becomes /-/internal/push/acquire//atgreen/house which 404s against the /:owner/:repo-name route. cave-shell then exits 'server busy, try again' and bd/dolt retries every ~3s forever, hammering the server. Fix: sed 's|^/*||' (strip all leading slashes), and consider distinguishing 404 (bad path — fail permanently) from real lock contention in the error message so clients don't retry a hopeless request.
close_reason: Fixed in 706e523: strip all leading slashes, distinguish 503 busy from other HTTP failures, don't leak push lock on git failure

title: Repo lists: add a [mirror] badge beside [private] for pull-mirror repos
description: Repo listings show (:span.badge "private") for private repos (views-base.lisp:477,586,632; views-repos.lisp:24 render-repo-tabs; also %repo-list-item at views-base.lisp:301). Add a matching [mirror] badge for repos that are pull-mirrors of another git repo. Mirror rows live in cave_mirrors (list-mirrors repo-id, model-repos.lisp:1171, has :direction pull|push). The list queries feeding these views (list-user-repos, list-org-repos, search-public-repos, etc.) don't carry mirror info — add an is-mirror flag to those queries (e.g. EXISTS against cave_mirrors WHERE direction='pull') rather than N+1 list-mirrors calls per row. Requested by Anthony 2026-09-12.
close_reason: mirror badge on dashboard/profile/org/explore/repo-header; is_mirror computed via EXISTS in list-user-repos, list-org-repos, search-public-repos, find-repo

title: Action-step log streaming silently broken: %run-action calls labels-local make-auth-metadata
description: main-git.lisp:517 %run-action's emit calls make-auth-metadata, defined only as a labels-local inside handle-runner (main-runner.lisp:162). SBCL flags it: undefined function CAVE::MAKE-AUTH-METADATA. At runtime the ignore-errors in emit swallows the error, so AppendStepLog is never sent for uses: action steps. Fix: promote make-auth-metadata to a top-level defun (falls out of the handle-runner labels->defuns flattening, see cave-6b4).
close_reason: make-auth-metadata promoted to top-level defun in main-git.lisp (loads before main-runner); labels binding removed — %run-action's AppendStepLog now works

title: Merge rules 7/8 read columns nothing can set (required_checks_pass, require_zero_unresolved_concerns)
description: model-issues.lisp:902,915 read repo columns whose only appearance elsewhere is DDL defaults in db.lisp:121,123 — update-repo-settings (model-repos.lisp:304) never writes them. So Rule 7 is permanently off and Rule 8 permanently on. Related: rules 2 and 3 (model-issues.lisp:857,862) are hardcoded :pass t and render permanent green checkmarks. Wire the settings or remove the rules.
close_reason: required_checks_pass + require_zero_unresolved_concerns now editable in Merge policy settings (model+route+UI); Rule 2 implemented for real (target branch existence via git-branches); fake always-green Rule 3 removed

title: Five ?path= URLs still unencoded (spaces/#/? break); url.lisp header claims fixed
description: server-repos.lisp:210, views-repos.lisp:512,515,526,532 still interpolate raw path into ?path= (tree/blob/raw links). url.lisp:3-8 header claims this was fixed. No raw-url helper exists. Fix alongside finishing url.lisp adoption (156 hand-built /~A/~A URLs remain, only 6 helper call sites).
close_reason: Added raw-url helper; tree redirect uses tree-url; blob Source link builds on blob-url; raw links use raw-url; raw-base-url encodes ref+dir; url.lisp header updated

title: chamber-repo-path skips ensure-valid-resource-name traversal guards
description: chamber.lisp:132 chamber-repo-path is byte-identical to repo-disk-path (server-api.lisp:519) minus the two ensure-valid-resource-name guards, and is used ~20x on the RPC path. Collapsing to one helper adds validation on the RPC path (behavior change, likely a hardening win). Decide deliberately. Related: GetDiffMergeBase smuggles diff text through base-ref field (chamber.proto:219) — wire format cleanup candidate. Found during whittling sweep 2026-09-12.

title: Instance stat 'N public repositories' silently caps at 50
description: views-base.lisp:457 renders (length repos) but server-accounts.lisp:219 passes (list-public-repos :limit 50), so the stat can never exceed 50. Fix: pass a real count from the model layer. Found during whittling sweep 2026-09-12; behavior change, out of scope for the cleanup branch.
close_reason: landing passes count-public-repos as :repo-count; stat no longer capped by the 50-row list

title: Issues list: filter by assignee (and maybe milestone)
description: Label + status filters exist on the issues list; assignee filter does not (list-issues has no assignee join). Add ?assignee= filter chip. Split from cave-w9r.

title: Claude PR review bot as a cave-actions workflow
description: PR opened → runner job diffs the branch, calls the Claude API, posts review comments via the existing API and sets a commit status. All plumbing (runners, tokens, statuses) exists; needs a workflow template + API-token scoping + prompt design.

title: Inbound email replies to issue/PR threads
description: Notifications become two-way: reply to a notification email and it lands as a comment. Needs a reply-to token address scheme + inbound SMTP handler (mailpit exists for dev; production needs an ingest path).

title: Fuzzy file finder ('t') and command palette
description: GitHub-style: press t on a repo page for fuzzy file jump (zoekt/file-tree already knows every filename), plus a small command palette overlay for nav. Mostly one JS overlay + a filenames endpoint.

title: Repo insights: commit activity, contributors, profile heatmap
description: Commit-activity sparkline per repo, contributor list with counts, and a GitHub-style contribution heatmap on user profiles. Data comes from git log walks (cacheable) + existing page-view/activity tables.

title: Atom/RSS feeds for releases, commits, and activity
description: Self-hosting-friendly: /releases.atom, /commits/:branch.atom, and a repo activity feed. Trivially cacheable; reuse existing model queries.
close_reason: releases.atom + commits.atom shipped in 8568510; no per-repo activity feed yet (no per-repo events query exists) — acceptable v1 scope

title: Workflow status badge SVGs
description: Serve /:owner/:repo/badge.svg (optionally ?workflow= / ?branch=) reflecting latest run status so READMEs on Cave can show build badges. Small hand-built SVG, cacheable.
close_reason: badge.svg shipped in 8568510

title: ocicl: 'ocicl install' should exit non-zero when a pinned system fails to download
description: Observed 2026-09-12: transient ghcr.io throttling made ocicl install log '; error downloading and installing <system>' for 8-33 systems yet exit 0, so CI steps pass with holes in the dep tree and builds fail later with confusing ASDF MISSING-DEPENDENCY errors. cave's containers.yaml now works around it with a grep+retry loop (f85bd65), but the right fix is upstream in ocicl/ocicl (atgreen owns it): track failures and exit non-zero, or add a --strict flag. Remove the cave workaround once fixed.

title: Stacked-PR feature has no write path — display code unreachable
description: cave_stacks table, find-stack-by-id, list-stack-pull-requests, and the stack panel in server-issues.lisp:339 exist, but the only write path is create-pull-request's :stack-id/:stack-order keys, which no caller passes. Either build stack creation or remove the feature. Found during whittling sweep 2026-09-12.
close_reason: Removed unreachable display path: create-pull-request stack keys, find-stack-by-id, list-stack-pull-requests, PR-page stack panel, .stack-list CSS. cave_stacks schema + columns remain (migrations append-only); git history preserves the code if stacks get a real write path.

title: Unify changeset vs pull-request vocabulary in model-issues.lisp
description: count-open-changesets, list-changeset-versions vs list-pull-requests, find-pull-request-by-id (changeset-id) — one table (cave_changesets), two vocabularies. Pick one. Large rename churn, needs its own pass.
close_reason: Lisp symbols unified on pull-request vocabulary; DB names and wire-visible workflow trigger names unchanged

title: git.lisp cohesion: markdown/camo/codeowners/linguist (~250 lines) are not git CLI integration
description: git.lisp:974-1302 hosts render-markdown, camo-*, codeowners-*, file-language and the linguist tables — none shell out to git. Split out (e.g. src/markup.lisp) like the model/views/server/main splits. Also: file-language vs file-language-info naming.

description: Multi-altitude functions worth extracting, found 2026-09-12: acceptor-dispatch-request (server-core.lisp:34, 7 levels), handle-workflow-logs-sse (server-releases.lisp:261, 9 levels), schedule-workflow-from-yaml (workflow.lisp:169), action-checkout (actions.lisp:452), handle-runner labels-as-defuns (main-runner.lisp:136, 628 lines), handle-watch-tasks (runner-service.lisp:358), compute-merge-eligibility (model-issues.lisp:816, 142 lines), view-repo-settings 11 identical sections (views-settings.lisp:5), view-blob inline JS (views-repos.lisp:452).

title: update-dep-status unconditionally NULLs pr-id and detail
description: model-activity.lisp:956 sets pr-id and detail to :null unless passed; callers deps-fix.lisp:215,244 pass only :pr-id (wiping detail), :250 passes only :detail (wiping pr-id). Docstring says 'optionally'. Make the update partial or make callers pass both.

description: main-app.lisp:56-58: --repo 'owner/cave-themes' is split and only owner is used; 'cave-themes' is hardcoded 3x in handle-sync-themes. Both callers pass ~A/cave-themes. Rename option to --owner and drop the parsing. CLI-visible change, out of scope for whittling.

description: auth.lisp:222 default &key force-admins '("atgreen") — never passed by the sole caller (main-admin.lisp:121), silently grants admin to one hardcoded username during migration. Should probably be a CLI flag or config value. Behavior change, out of scope for whittling.

title: ForgeFed/ActivityPub federation (exploratory)
description: Maximal cool factor: federate stars/follows/issues via ForgeFed. Big protocol commitment — explicitly deferred until the core surface is finished (see review backlog). Park research notes here.
